rationale: IMPLEMENTED_AND_MERGED: CodingCommands receipt custody. Atomic directory reservations allocate never-reused journal names before external entry across fresh/cooperating adapters. Single commands persist intent before entry, then only their own completed result. Bundles and change reports share this existing-owner allocator. Original receipts remain immutable; pre-entry allocation/storage failure causes zero execution; post-entry persistence failure retains unknown intent and never redispatches. Reservations survive interruption, not stale locks to clear. Current cooperating writers/trusted local evidence only; no power-loss or exactly-once effect guarantee.
